articles.title: An 800-Year-Old Toilet Hid a Secret Notebook — and It Still Stinks!
articles.summary: Imagine digging into a really old toilet and finding a tiny leather notebook covered in secret Latin writing! That’s what happened in Germany, where a 13th-century merchant’s book was pulled from a stinky latrine. Experts are using high-tech tools to read the wax pages.

articles.title: Madonna Pays Rent for Musicians in the Building Where She Got Her Start!
articles.summary: Pop superstar Madonna surprised musicians in New York by paying their rent for a month. She teamed up with a credit card company to cover up to $1,999.99 for each tenant at the Music Building, the same place where she rehearsed early in her career. It’s a huge help for struggling artists.

articles.title: Rapper Young MC Drops Out of Concert After Learning It Was ‘Trump-Backed’
articles.summary: Young MC agreed to perform at a D.C. concert called Freedom 250, thinking it was just a regular show. Then he found out it was linked to former President Trump, and fans got angry. He quickly quit, saying he was tricked — it was a ‘bait-and-switch.’
